messages:
carla: Heads-up: apiserver/etcd errors in us-west starting ~01:22 UTC. controller-manager losing leader lease repeatedly and GPU provisioning pods stuck Pending.

infra-bot: [ALERT] etcd_client_tls_handshake_errors increased (us-west) and apiserver_5xx_rate rising

ben: Any recent cert or automation changes?

carla: We had an automated cert-rotation job (internal-cert-rotator) run last night. Looks like it rotated etcd client certs on two controlplane hosts but failed on the third due to a transient API timeout. Logs show alternating TLS handshake failures to that node.

hiro: Controller-manager log snippet around 01:23: 

```
E0609 01:23:14.112 leaderelection.go:243] failed to renew lease: context deadline exceeded
E0609 01:23:14.113 controller_manager.go:176] leader lost: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
I0609 01:23:14.215 leaderelection.go:210] attempting to acquire lease kube-system/controller-manager...
```

carla: etcd logs on the mismatched node show TLS handshake error and certificate CN mismatch: `tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: bad certificate (CN=etcd-client-20260508)` while others present `etcd-client-20260608`.

ben: That would cause the etcd client to drop RPCs to that member intermittently—write path latency spikes and quorum operations slow -> leader renew misses.

carla: I verified with this command: `openssl s_client -connect 10.12.5.23:2379 -showcerts` and inspected the cert dates. The automation didn't push the latest cert to node cp-03.

hiro: Fast mitigations we ran: 1) paused the rotator job, 2) rolled back certs on the two updated nodes to the previous version to reestablish a consistent set, 3) restarted etcd on the bad node after uploading correct cert. Leader stabilized after ~90s and controller-manager resumed normal reconciling.

carla: GPU provisioning backlog snapshot during the blip: 22 Pending pods in `gpu-onboard` namespace. Many controllers retried and some fell back to hosted pools.

infra-bot: incident-created: INC-20260609-901 (severity: medium)

ben: Cost impact: we routed approx 160k tokens to hosted fallback during the ~28m window. Finance estimate incremental ~$480. We'll need this in the incident cost attach.

hiro: Longer term fixes proposed:
- add a preflight: verify cert distribution success across all etcd members before completing rotation (check cert fingerprint match)
- make rotator job atomic: only rotate one node at a time and validate quorum before proceeding
- add alert: etcd_client_tls_handshake_errors > 0 for 1m -> page controlplane owners
- instrument controller-manager with consecutive_lease_renew_failures metric (alert after 3)

carla: I'll open a repo PR to add fingerprint checks and the one-by-one rotation strategy. Also drafting a runbook section: "cert-rotator mismatch -> etcd TLS handshake failures -> leader election churn" with commands to detect and emergency rollback steps.

ben: For immediate safety, let's keep rotator paused for 24h and do a manual canary in staging.

hiro: I pushed a quick detection snippet for runbook: `kubectl -n kube-system get endpoints etcd -o jsonpath='{.subsets[*].addresses[*].ip}' | xargs -n1 -I{} sh -c "openssl s_client -connect {}:2379 -servername etcd 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -subject | sed -n 's/subject= //p'"` to list CNs.

carla: Assigning follow-ups: carla -> runbook + PR, ben -> finance cost attach + rotator pause, hiro -> staging canary + metric. Will update after staging canary tomorrow morning. Thanks :thumbsup:
